notes: Three branches end at كلهم عن شعبة, بهذا الإسناد; the tail is shared by the three main groups.
The variant group («وفي حديث شبابة قال سمعت زهدم بن مضرب ... عمران بن حصين») names a different transmitter for the same saying; it is not a route and does not take the shared tail.
Wording remarks (ينذرون / يوفون, لا أدري) and «كما قال ابن جعفر» carry no transmitter of their own and are left out.
